prompt_with_your_photo: Image 1 is the person. Image 2 is a faceless grey mannequin that shows only the pose. Make a photograph of the person from image 1: keep their exact face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle and any distinctive features. Copy the body pose from image 2 exactly: the same position of the head, torso, arms, hands, legs and feet, and the same camera angle. Do not copy the mannequin itself: no grey skin, no bald head, no mannequin joints. They wear an elegant, modest, fully opaque ivory silk dress with long flowing fabric. Fine-art portrait photography, soft window light from the left, warm neutral plaster studio backdrop, 85 mm lens, natural skin texture, calm and graceful mood. Tasteful and fully clothed, no sheer or see-through fabric, no nudity, no text, no logo.
